title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's Love Story Has Reportedly Reached Its Next Chapter
metaDescription: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce got engaged in August 2025 after two years together — and multiple outlets now report the couple has since married.
html:
What started as one of the most-watched celebrity relationships of the decade has reportedly moved into its next phase: marriage.

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's relationship became public in 2023, after the Kansas City Chiefs tight end revealed he'd tried — unsuccessfully, at first — to get Swift's attention during her Eras Tour stop in Kansas City. Their romance quickly became one of the most closely tracked in recent pop culture history, following Swift to NFL games and Kelce to Swift's tour stops around the world.

The couple confirmed their engagement in August 2025, after roughly two years together. Since then, multiple entertainment outlets have reported that Swift and Kelce have married, framing it as the natural next step for a relationship that played out largely in public view from the very beginning.

Neither Swift nor Kelce has laid out a detailed public account of the ceremony itself, and specifics like date and location have circulated in reports without official confirmation from the couple. What is consistent across coverage is the broader arc: a pop star and an NFL star, one unlikely sideline cameo, and a relationship that's now reportedly reached the altar.

Given how much of their relationship has already played out under public scrutiny, it's likely only a matter of time before Swift or Kelce addresses the marriage reports directly — on a podcast, in song, or simply by showing up somewhere wearing a ring neither of them has to explain.
